capabilities: run preconfigured prompts on selected text or the full note
configure custom prompts with model and temperature
insert the model's response at the cursor position
extras: The README says Ollama is currently available as a MacOS app and the plugin connects to its default port by default.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run local LLM prompts on note content.
summary: AI plugin that sends prompts with the selected text or full note to a locally installed Ollama model and inserts the result at the cursor.
